read.thesis: Backlog 44 GW ($13.5B) but bookings slowed and FY26 volume cut to 16–17 GW; management is deferring capex and pivoting to project-based contracts with pricing up post-232, though volumes are soft.

capex.quote: Capital Expenditures Guidance -- $0.6 billion to $0.8 billion, a reduction from $0.8 billion to $1.0 billion as management deferred certain project spending.

triggers.label: Malaysia 1.8 GW binary decision
triggers.quote: We expect the operating decision regarding our Malaysia facility to be binary

triggers.label: Quarterly US bookings 1.4 GW at $0.36/W
triggers.quote: we have booked approximately 4.9 gigawatts at approximately $0.35 -- $0.36 per watt inclusive of adjusters

triggers.label: Post-232 repricing of early-stage deals
triggers.quote: Since the announcement of 232, we have revised and increased our pricing.

triggers.label: FY26 volume cut 17.0–18.2 to 16–17 GW
triggers.quote: revised downward from 17.0 gigawatts to 18.2 gigawatts due to lower India domestic and international Series 6 sales.

triggers.label: Capex cut $0.8–1.0B to $0.6–0.8B
triggers.quote: a reduction from $0.8 billion to $1.0 billion as management deferred certain project spending.

guidance.quote: Full Year Volume Guidance -- 16.0 gigawatts to 17.0 gigawatts, revised downward from 17.0 gigawatts to 18.2 gigawatts
updated from a previous range of $4.9 billion to $5.2 billion reflecting reduced volume expectations
